```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(htmltools)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)
library(tigris)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

if (!requireNamespace("ggiraph", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop(
    "Package 'ggiraph' is required. Install with: install.packages('ggiraph')",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::tags$style(HTML("
    /* fill the map column (wide column on the right) */
    section.map-column,
    section.map-column .chart-wrapper,
    section.map-column .chart-stage,
    .vertical-layout-fill .map-column .chart-wrapper,
    .vertical-layout-fill .map-column .chart-stage {
      flex: 1 1 auto;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      min-height: 0;
      background-color: #f0f2f5 !important;
    }
    .map-panel-fill {
      flex: 1 1 auto;
      width: 100%;
      min-height: calc(100vh - 120px);
      height: calc(100vh - 120px);
      background-color: #f0f2f5;
    }
    .map-panel-fill .html-widget,
    .map-panel-fill .girafe,
    .map-panel-fill .girafe_container_std {
      width: 100% !important;
      height: 100% !important;
      max-width: none !important;
      background-color: #f0f2f5 !important;
    }
    .map-panel-fill svg.girafe-svg {
      width: 100% !important;
      height: 100% !important;
    }
  "))
)
```


```{r data prep, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}

shp <- st_read("inputs/sections.shp", quiet = TRUE) |>
  st_transform(5070) |>
  arrange(MAP_UNIT_N) |>
  filter(!grepl("water", MAP_UNIT_N, ignore.case = TRUE))

report_files <- list.files(
  "reports",
  pattern = "\\.html$",
  full.names = FALSE
)

reports <- tibble(
  MAP_UNIT_N = report_files |>
    tools::file_path_sans_ext() |>
    (\(x) gsub("_", " ", x))() |>
    trimws(),
  path = file.path("reports", report_files)
)

shp <- shp |>
  left_join(reports, by = "MAP_UNIT_N") |>
  mutate(
    has_report = !is.na(path),
    onclick = ifelse(
      has_report,
      paste0("window.open(\"./", path, "\",\"_blank\");"),
      "alert(\"No report available yet for this section.\");"
    ),
    tooltip = paste0(
      "<b>", MAP_UNIT_N, "</b>",
      ifelse(has_report, "<br><i>Click to open report</i>", "<br><i>No report yet</i>")
    )
  )

states_map <- tigris::states(cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  st_as_sf() |>
  st_transform(5070) |>
  st_filter(shp, .predicate = st_intersects)

```

```{r clickable map, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

map_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = states_map,
    fill = "#424345",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_sf_interactive(
    data = shp,
    aes(tooltip = tooltip, onclick = onclick),
    fill = "#f0f2f5",
    color = "#f0f2f5",
    linewidth = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.25
  ) +
  coord_sf(crs = 5070, expand = TRUE) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#f0f2f5", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#f0f2f5", color = NA)
  )

map_widget <- girafe(ggobj = map_plot, width_svg = 16, height_svg = 9) |>
  girafe_options(
    opts_zoom(min = 0.5, max = 10),
    opts_toolbar(position = "topright"),
    opts_hover(css = "stroke:#ffffff;stroke-width:2;cursor:pointer;"),
    opts_hover_inv(css = "fill-opacity:0.35;"),
    opts_selection(type = "none"),
    opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
  )

map_widget$sizingPolicy$browser$fill <- TRUE
map_widget$sizingPolicy$browser$padding <- 0
map_widget$sizingPolicy$knitr$figure <- FALSE
map_widget$sizingPolicy$knitr$defaultWidth <- "100%"
map_widget$sizingPolicy$knitr$defaultHeight <- 720

map_widget <- htmlwidgets::onRender(
  map_widget,
  "
  function(el, x) {
    var bg = '#f0f2f5';
    function paintBg(node) {
      if (!node || !node.style) return;
      node.style.setProperty('background-color', bg, 'important');
      node.style.setProperty('background', bg, 'important');
    }
    paintBg(el);
    var p = el.parentElement;
    while (p) {
      paintBg(p);
      if (p.tagName === 'SECTION' || p.classList.contains('dashboard-column')) break;
      p = p.parentElement;
    }
    var svg = el.querySelector('svg');
    if (svg) {
      paintBg(svg);
      svg.querySelectorAll('rect').forEach(function(r) {
        var f = (r.getAttribute('fill') || '').toLowerCase();
        if (f === '#ffffff' || f === 'white' || f === '#fcfcfc') {
          r.setAttribute('fill', bg);
        }
      });
    }

    function resizeMap() { window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')); }
    setTimeout(resizeMap, 50);
    if (window.jQuery) {
      jQuery(document).one('flexdashboard:layoutcomplete', function() {
        paintBg(el);
        resizeMap();
      });
    }
  }
  "
)

htmltools::tags$div(
  class = "map-panel-fill",
  style = "background-color: #f0f2f5 !important;",
  map_widget
)

```
